definitions.uniqueMotionConcepts: Distinct concept and sense IDs with a current hash-checked, Aarav-compatible capture. Multiple captures can represent one concept.
definitions.aaravCompatible: Distinct motion captures with current file hashes and retained-rig technical evidence. Playback checks do not establish ASL correctness.
definitions.expandedResearchTextMotions: Compatible captures eligible for explicit research text opt-in. Ambiguous meanings can still require a sense choice; unreviewed aliases are not automatically enabled.
definitions.expandedResearchTextConcepts: Distinct concept and sense IDs reachable through research text mappings, including meanings requiring a choice.
definitions.approvedSigns: Signs with recorded linguistic approval. Technical playback never grants this status.
definitions.textUnavailableCaptures: Compatible captures excluded from expanded text mapping; available for inspection only.
